summary: New lib/tmux.sh: tmux_name (moved from bin/harness) and tmux_reap, which kills h-<run> of runs with meta.env+ended, no live driver (re-checked), no PAUSE; spares a resume's newer session and a name a live/paused run shares (a.b vs a-b). harness gc calls it before git fetch; queue.sh as it exits, before the debrief. start refuses run id queue. 3 checks; 299 → 302.
verified_how: tests: 302/302 (bash tests/run.sh, then lib/check.sh green in 524 s); the three new checks watched failing first (298/302, plus one desk check cascading on the unreaped sleep 600 decoys, fixed by unconditional cleanup); mutation run on a scratch private tmux server: with the shared-name guard off h-held-x would be killed, with fresh's ended touched now h-fresh would be.

discoveries.text: tmux_name is lossy (a.b and a-b of any project are both h-a-b): tmux_reap checks every state dir of the root for a same-name run that is live, paused or not ended and keeps the session then. cmd_start's resume kill-session still kills a same-name session of another run (pre-existing, like L2-06's svc note).

The queue-runner reap check (tests/run.sh, first runner block) creates h-proj-$D, h-proj-$D-2, h-queue and the desk session before the runner and kills all four after, so the desk checks still start with no desk session and no 'sleep 600' pane. The gc reap block is the last before the summary and removes its decoy state dirs (livey/held-x hold the suite's pid).

proposed_changes: L3-04 step 1 says gc calls the helper 'through act': gc prints the helper's own lines (+ reaped … / would: tmux kill-session -t =<s> (<run> ended) / ! could not kill …), the unit step's shape, as plan §9 says; act couldn't name the run.
L3-04 step 2's paused decoy has no ended, so it can't exercise the PAUSE guard: the check adds pausx (PAUSE + ended), fresh (a resume's session) and held.x/held-x (a shared name), per plan §6.3.
